title: Stage 1 - match.signal
description: The first thing either side learns: a match exists. Deliberately thin - match id and category only. NO score, NO attributes, NO prices, NO free text. The switchboard has already decided the match is worth sending, so no confidence figure crosses to the agent; what the agent can do next is said as a word on the check_matches entry (see TOOLS.md), never as a number. Anything richer requires escalation through the consent gates.

counterparty_type.description: Whether the matched card is a WANT or a HAVE.
